steps.clue: Recapture both Wards, defeat the Oni and awaken the World Seed.
Build the Maneki-Neko and rescue the cat to obtain the Nekomancer.
Light the eleven lanterns with the Nekomancer and investigate the spirit in the War Room.
Recover the Fox Mask and complete the mask-wall sequence.
Chase the Fox Mask and collect the evidence revealing the first suspect.
Complete the coin purse, poison, Sake Cup, clock and flag steps to reveal the remaining evidence.
Match the evidence to each suspect and solve the Zodiac Dial.
Defeat the Onryo and open the route to the volcano.
Travel to the volcano and defeat Nyxara.
